concepts.description: A structural unit representing a self-contained component of the AUV system.
A physical or logical platform representing the robotic body of the AUV, interacting with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A logical component within the AUV system responsible for managing and directing operations or behaviors.
A basic data type defined within the AUV_Module to represent fundamental values.
A structured data type defined within the AUV_Module that groups multiple values of potentially different types.
A named field within a Composite Type that holds a specific piece of data.
A signal or action defined within an Interface that can be triggered, optionally taking parameters and returning a value.
A callable operation defined within the AUV_Module that takes input parameters and returns a value.

instances.description: The top-level module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform of the AUV system, using the Sensors and Actuators interfaces defined by AUV_Module.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to receive sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuator outputs.
A controller within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive operational commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input commands.
A controller for the Last Response Engine within AUV_Module, using the Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output commands.
A controller within AUV_Module responsible for autopilot functionality, using the Outputs interface.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values.
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, recording radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A value of type real in SVec representing the radial component of the spherical vector.
A value of type real in SVec representing the polar component of the spherical vector.
A value of type real in SVec representing the azimuth component of the spherical vector.
A composite type representing an obstacle, recording ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id, and obs_hdng values.
A value of type real in Obstacle representing the north-south relative distance.
A value of type real in Obstacle representing the east-west relative distance.
A value of type real in Obstacle representing the depth of the obstacle.
A value of type real in Obstacle representing the identifier of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec in Obstacle representing the heading of the obstacle.
A value of type SVec in the Sensors interface representing the heading measurement.
A value of type Obstacle in the Sensors interface representing detected obstacle data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module containing events for task and mode management (note: likely a typo for Inputs).
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signalling the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an obstacle avoidance control mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a manual operation mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a heading control mode.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters, returning a real value representing the requested heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type representing a close-distance record, storing horiz_cda and vert_cda of type real, and id of type nat.
A value of type real in Close representing the horizontal closest distance of approach.
A value of type real in Close representing the vertical closest distance of approach.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real value.
